newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Athletics-Ireland's O'Sullivan aims to win in Turin.
newsitem.headline: Athletics-Ireland's O'Sullivan aims to win in Turin.

text.p: Ireland's Sonia O'Sullivan said on Friday she aims to make amends for her defeat at the world indoor championships earlier this month by winning Sunday's world cross-country championship in Turin.

O'Sullivan, 27, had to be content with the silver medal in the final of the 3,000 metres at the world indoor championships in Paris after she was overtaken in the last few strides by Romanian Gabriela Szabo.
"I screwed up in Paris so I'm definitely looking to win in Turin. I am still hungry for success," O'Sullivan said.

Her only previous appearance in the world cross-country championships was in the United States in 1992 when she finished seventh in a race in which Irish compatriot Catherina McKiernan win the first of her four successive silver medals.
